parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description: The database engine type. Only **MySQL** is supported.

parameters.name: DBVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the database engine. Valid values:

- **5.6**

- **5.7**

- **8.0**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region.

> Call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the information about all available regions of your account, including the region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
